Renamed `totalAmount` → `grossAmount` across all six files that carried it:

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `api/src/main/java/mn/shop/api/Order.java:15,27` | entity field + `getTotalAmount()` → `getGrossAmount()` |
| `api/src/main/java/mn/shop/api/OrderDto.java:5,8` | record component + accessor call in `of()` |
| `api/src/main/resources/graphql/order.graphqls:4` | schema field |
| `web/src/lib/orders.ts:6,25` | GraphQL query selection + `Order` interface |
| `web/src/components/OrderSummary.tsx:4,12` | both read sites |
| `web/src/generated/graphql-generated.ts:11` | `Order` type |

Verified: `mvn -o test` in `api/` builds and passes (1 test); `npm run build` (tsc) and `npm test` (vitest) in `web/` both pass.

Two things worth flagging:

- **I edited the generated file despite its "do not edit" banner.** `graphql-generated.ts` claims it's regenerated from `order.graphqls` on every build, but `web/package.json` has no codegen step — `build` is just `tsc --noEmit`, and there's no codegen config anywhere in the repo. The checked-in file is the only copy, so leaving it would have left the generated `Order` type contradicting the schema. If codegen actually lives outside this repo, re-run it and discard my edit to that one file.

- **The JPA column name changes implicitly.** `Order.grossAmount` has no `@Column`, so Hibernate's default naming strategy now maps it to `gross_amount` instead of `total_amount`. There are no migrations or `application.properties` in the repo, so I couldn't tell whether the schema is auto-generated or managed elsewhere. If an existing database backs this, it needs either a column rename migration or `@Column(name = "total_amount")` to pin the old name.

I left the `totalAmount` mention in the `orders.test.ts` doc comment (line 9) alone — it's prose describing why the test deliberately avoids naming the field, and it reads correctly referring to the pre-rename name. Say the word if you'd rather it be updated.
